heated.name: Nick Taylor
heated.text: Play this game!!! One of my favourite "cozy" games (term has some negative connotations now because the genre is flooded with slop clones, so I use it reservedly). Some lovely fishing and cooking. Also the vending machine in front of your house is how bakeries have started operating here 😆
